lessons.title: Calculator shape lookup broken across 8 deliveries
lessons.description: Calculator loaded 0 shapes because the import path changed but the wrapper method still called the old path. Every bid silently returned $0 weight. Survived 8 deliveries because the wrapping try/except turned the ImportError into a silent error response.
lessons.detection_method: Call the Bridge method and check if the return value contains real data vs an error dict. Import-time tests pass because the module loads; the bug is at call time.
lessons.fix_pattern: Read the target module's actual exports (dir(module)) and find the correct function name. Update the import. Verify by calling the method and checking the return value.

lessons.title: 3 Bridge methods importing non-existent functions
lessons.description: api.py imported calculate_consumable, get_status, and get_benchmarks from their respective modules. None of these functions existed. The correct exports were estimate_joint, for_morning_briefing/get_continuity_alerts, and BENCHMARKS.
lessons.detection_method: For every 'from bridge.X import Y' in api.py, check that Y actually exists in module X using hasattr(module, Y).
lessons.fix_pattern: Import the module, list its exports, find the closest match to the expected function name, update the import and adjust the calling code to match the new function's signature.

lessons.title: VJ self-repair found 11 more silent import bugs
lessons.description: Virtual Joseph's first scan of the codebase found 11 Bridge methods importing functions that don't exist in their target modules. Same class as sweep4 P0 and the 3 from v6.1.2. Includes shop_floor (4 methods), emr_predictor (2), bid_chain, stl_generator, calibration, vault, and keyvault.
lessons.detection_method: Automated: SelfRepairEngine._scan_import_paths() checks every import in api.py against actual module exports.
lessons.fix_pattern: Same as v612_import_3. Match export names to actual module dir().

lessons.title: v1 takeoff controller silent-zero pricing
lessons.description: labor_cost() returns 'total_labor' but controller read 'total'. bid_total() returns 'bid_total' but controller read 'total'. Every v1-pipeline bid silently returned $0.
lessons.detection_method: Check that the keys a caller reads from a function's return dict actually exist in that dict. Run the full chain and verify the final number is non-zero.
lessons.fix_pattern: Add fallback reads: lc.get('total_labor', lc.get('total', 0)). Preserves backward compat while fixing the mismatch.

lessons.title: Test hardcodes version string instead of pattern
lessons.description: test_release_tag_format asserted '3.5' in tag. When version bumped to 6.1.1, the test failed. The tag was correct; the test was stale.
lessons.detection_method: Search test files for hardcoded version strings. Check if any assertion contains a literal version number.
lessons.fix_pattern: Replace hardcoded version with regex: re.match(r'steel-office@\d+\.\d+', tag). Locks the SHAPE not the specific value.

lessons.title: Em-dash test checks wrong Unicode character
lessons.description: Two tests assert '-' (U+002D hyphen-minus) not in text, but should check for U+2014 (em-dash). The text has 0 em-dashes but uses hyphens for markdown bullets, causing false failure.
lessons.detection_method: Byte-level check: is the character in the assertion literal actually the character the test claims to be checking for?
lessons.fix_pattern: Replace '-' with '\u2014' in the assertion. Single character fix per test.

lessons.title: Sheet-ID regex rejects legitimate 3-digit IDs
lessons.description: v3.5.12 tightened digit limit from {1,3} to {1,2} to prevent false positives. But S-001 and F-001 are standard structural sheet IDs. The word boundary already prevented the original false positive (MA1234).
lessons.detection_method: Test with real-world inputs (S-001, F-001, S-12) not just adversarial inputs. Every tightening should be tested against the full range of legitimate inputs.
lessons.fix_pattern: Restore {1,3}. The word boundary handles the false positive that motivated the tightening. Don't over-tighten when the existing guard already works.

lessons.title: CHANGELOG numbers don't match pytest output
lessons.description: CHANGELOG claimed '1,192 passed, 0 failed' but pytest reported 1,201 passed, 3 failed. The failures were stale tests, not real bugs, but the numbers were wrong.
lessons.detection_method: After writing the CHANGELOG, run pytest and compare the actual output to the claimed numbers. Byte-for-byte.
lessons.fix_pattern: Run pytest, copy the actual numbers into the CHANGELOG. If there are failures, document them even if they're stale tests. Honesty in headlines.

lessons.title: 111 bare except: clauses across 33 files
lessons.description: Bare 'except:' catches KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit. In production, this means Ctrl+C and process signals get swallowed. The correct form is 'except Exception:'.

lessons.title: 327 em-dashes in bridge/api.py (AI signal in code)
lessons.description: Em-dashes in Python docstrings and comments signal AI-generated code. Voice rule originally exempted internal Python. Joseph went beyond the rule and purged all 327.
lessons.fix_pattern: Replace em-dashes with hyphens or rephrase.

lessons.title: Integration paths are where real bugs hide
lessons.description: Every major bug in the sprint was found at integration boundaries, not within individual modules. File-level code looks correct. Unit tests pass. The bug surfaces only when Module A calls Module B with real data.
lessons.detection_method: Exercise full chains end-to-end: AISC -> weight -> hours -> labor -> margin -> cost -> STL -> governance. Any break in the chain reveals an integration bug.
lessons.fix_pattern: Don't trust unit tests alone. Run integration chains. Cross-phase testing catches what per-phase testing misses.

lessons.title: No single perspective catches every bug
lessons.description: Sweep4 caught bugs the manual tests missed. The sim caught bugs Joseph missed. Joseph caught bugs the sim missed. VJ caught bugs everyone missed. Each perspective has blind spots. Diverse probing finds more issues than deep probing from one angle.
lessons.detection_method: Run multiple scan types: static analysis, integration tests, adversarial probes, bias detection, CHANGELOG verification. Each catches a different class.
lessons.fix_pattern: Don't assume clean after one pass. Run VJ scan, then manual review, then sim. The bugs that survive all three are the ones that need creative thinking to find.

lessons.title: AI Dismissal Bias
lessons.description: When user shares another AI's output with project context, evaluate on merit. Do not dismiss.
lessons.detection_method: Check if response dismisses another AI's contextualized contribution
lessons.fix_pattern: Assess each point individually. Credit existing work. Identify new value. Never blanket-dismiss.
